The UPSC CSE 2025 Result is out and inspiring stories from toppers are motivating lakhs of aspirants across the country. In this special session, UPSC AIR 10 Ujjwal Priyank shares his inspiring journey of cracking the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 and reveals whether it is possible to become an IAS officer without going to Delhi for coaching.

In this exclusive UPSC Topper Interview, Rank 10 Ujjwal Priyank talks about his UPSC preparation strategy, how he prepared for UPSC Prelims, UPSC Mains, and UPSC Interview, and what resources he used during his preparation. Aspirants searching for UPSC topper strategy, UPSC AIR 10 strategy, UPSC 2025 topper interview, or UPSC preparation tips will find this discussion extremely helpful.

After the announcement of the UPSC 2025 results, many aspirants want to know how toppers prepared, how they managed current affairs for UPSC, how they practiced answer writing for UPSC mains, and how they maintained consistency during preparation. In this interview, Ujjwal Priyank UPSC AIR 10 shares practical tips and guidance for aspirants preparing for UPSC 2026 and UPSC 2027.

If you are preparing for the UPSC Civil Services Exam, this UPSC topper talk will give you clarity about the preparation strategy, mindset, and discipline required to crack the UPSC exam.

Stay connected with PW OnlyIAS and OnlyIAS UPSC for more UPSC topper interviews, UPSC preparation strategy, UPSC result analysis, and guidance for UPSC aspirants.
